slides.title: *5 defaults that take decisions off your day.
Same *start time.
slides.body: Work begins at the same time every day. No negotiating with yourself.

slides.title: Same *first task.
slides.body: The first hour always goes to your most important project.

slides.title: *Clothes out the night before.
slides.body: Gym kit or work clothes. One less choice before coffee.

slides.title: A *default lunch.
slides.body: Pick two go-to meals for workdays. Save variety for the weekend.

slides.title: Phone charges *outside the bedroom.
slides.body: Buy a cheap alarm clock. Your mornings change.

slides.title: Willpower runs out. *Defaults don't.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
